mental_profile.notes: Publicly reported (beIN SPORTS, 10 Aug 2026) to have rejected a move to Al-Ittihad after the Saudi club agreed to pay his EUR 70m release clause in August 2026 - chose to stay at Porto.

data_quality.notes: Current club (Porto) and EUR 70m release clause are sourced to a beIN SPORTS article dated 10 Aug 2026 reporting that Al-Ittihad triggered the clause and Mora refused. The '10 goals, 4 assists' figure in that article refers to his DEBUT Liga Portugal season (2024/25, aged 17), so it is deliberately NOT entered as 2025/26 data; 2025/26 stats are null. Age approximate (born 2007). estimated_fee_eur_m set equal to the release clause because any buyer effectively has to pay it. Secondary positions are the researcher's inference.
